objective: Proof with machine check: a start whose live knots come in partner pairs, every knot a candidate with all but its partner, blocks the candidate pairs and open counts 2^(n-1), keeps that form at every round, with N(t+1) = 2^(N(t)/2) - N(t-1); it never closes, and its counts outrun every cluster reading on a finite complex.
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (machine check M1-M4 held; referee pending): partnered starts (2n live knots in partner pairs, blocks the non-partner pairs, open 2^(n-1)) keep that form every round with N(t+1) = 2^(N(t)/2) - N(t-1) (6, 8, 10, 24, 4,086, 2^2043 - 24 for n = 3), never stall or close, and run away faster than every exponential; no cluster reading with polynomially large clusters can follow them; any part of a stage bounds the next round below (maximal cliques of the part less blocks and lone knots), and a partnered part with no outside common candidate reads two rounds.
title: Paired starts grow forever, faster than any cluster reading
